description: Structured lookup of Slovak methodological guidance documents by their extremes, without the text (replaces the legacy query_prassi). Filters, all optional and combined with AND: fonte (financnasprava, mfsr-spravodajca, nbs-metodicke, uvo-metodicke), section, tipo (exact, case-insensitive), numero (prefix, for example 10/DZPaU or MF/0138; written with its slashes), anno, data_from and data_to (publication date YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), ente (substring). sort (data_desc default, data_asc, tipo, anno_numero); a missing value is always last. limit (1..50, default 20) and offset page the result; every row carries total, the size of the filtered set. Rows: id, fonte, source_id, ente, tipo, section, numero, anno, data, oggetto (first 300 characters), source_url (the PDF), text_source, total. A call without any parameter lists the newest documents. Read a document with sk-metodika_doc. Guidance is not a source of law. Example: {"fonte": "nbs-metodicke", "sort": "data_desc", "limit": 10}.
